title: FGFR3-TRACE (Tracking Mutations and Fusions in Urothelial Cancer): Use of anonymized patient samples for the establishment of newly developed assays for the detection of diagnostically relevant cancer biomarkers.
summary: In the FGFR3-TRACE study, urine, blood, or tissue samples from patients with urothelial carcinoma (bladder or urinary tract cancer) are used to detect specific genetic alterations in the FGFR3 gene using an innovative, rapid, and highly sensitive method. The aim is to develop a highly sensitive assay to identify potential therapeutic options for patients at an early stage and thereby improve treatment outcomes.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm of other and unspecified urinary organs

interventions.name: Observational study (analytical laboratory study): Urine, blood, or tissue samples from patients with urothelial carcinoma are analyzed using digital PCR to detect the presence of FGFR3 alterations, aiming to provide results that may inform potential treatment options.

criteria:
